Name: Bog's Fantasy Maru
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[left][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/XYqHf1Rf/retro-bookcase-(7).png[/img][/u][/left]
[size=3]﻿Happy Holidays to however you celebrate around the world you goblins, witches, forest folk and ghouls! Bog's Fantasy Maru is here! Maru is a tinker fairy in my Fantasy Valley collection of portraits and sprites. She even floats around flying with her wings around the valley!

Here is the full list of retextured portraits and sprites:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]Main Maru portraits and sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Winter Maru portraits and sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Hospital Maru portraits and sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Beach Maru portraits and sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
In this mod Maru even has a special dress for the flowers dance as well as a special new dress for the wedding. These dresses and accessories are from [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/9382caf072]Lune's Whimsy Collection[/url] and [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/7176dd8e69]Lune's Ethereal Collection[/url]! So you could even match Maru for the flower dance! I will be having all fem marriage candidates wear Whimsy Collection dresses with the flower crowns. Huge thank you to Lune again for giving me access to their beautiful full suite of clothing to use on the Fantasy Valley series. 

The next Fantasy character to be released will be.... EMILY!!! 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34756]Bog's Fantasy Caroline[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34858]Bog's Fantasy Marnie
[/url]
Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods]my other mods[/url] as i have been working hard to turn the entire game into my aesthetic!!!

If you would like to see updates on my mods or get notified when a mod is published join my [url=https://discord.gg/tCpM2s2wa4]Discord Server[/url]﻿
We have a great community of mod authors who are making mods as well for the goblins, witches, forest folk & ghouls. 

All my [url=https://linktr.ee/BogWytch]Social Links[/url]﻿ <---

Again thank you so much for everything. I hope to continue to bring joy to your Stardew Valley games.

<3
Bog & Abagaianye﻿[/size]
